data.narrative:
TrustPoint is a Seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Patrick Shannon and Chris DeMay that has raised $6.5M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector includes 5 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though few operate at TrustPoint's stage and scale.

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method here. Using total capital raised ($6.5M) as a valuation proxy and applying a typical Seed-to-next-stage step-up multiplier of 2.5x yields an implied valuation of $16M. Peer-median triangulation cannot be applied due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within Space & Aerospace—while 14 sector peers exist, none of the narrow filters produced three or more datapoints. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples is also inapplicable, as private companies rarely disclose revenue; the sector median P/S across the five public comps is 27.4x, but cannot be meaningfully applied without TrustPoint's revenue figure.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $14M to $19M, with a median point of $16M. This range reflects a ±15% band around the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the company's actual revenue trajectory, the applicability of traditional stage multiples to frontier aerospace, and the absence of direct private peer comparables at seed stage.
